title: Mkpesa A Na-anụ n'elu Mkpọtụ
intro: Ị na-anụ olu na-ebilite site n'obodo ebe mmegbu aghọọla ihe a na-emekarị. Enweghị ngosipụta ike na-aza mkpesa ahụ; kama, arịrịọ kpọmkwem na-erute Allah, azịza ya na-adakwasị obi ofufe n'onwe ya. Ònye mere mkpesa ahụ, ajụjụ dị aṅaa sochiri, na eziokwu dị aṅaa ka e kwadoro?
clues: Mmegbu ndị gbara m gburugburu mere ka m nwee nsogbu.
Ekwupụtara m mkpesa ahụ ozugbo nye Allah n'ime mkpesa nkeonwe.
Allah nụrụ mkpesa ahụ wee zaa ajụjụ gbasara nkwenye m.
Azịza ya jụrụ m otu m ga-esi ghara ikwere na Allah, onye bụ otu na onye kachasị elu.
M wee jụọ ihe mere Allah ji kwesị inyere ndị na-ekweghị ekwe aka.
Abụ m Uzair, aha m pụtara na Surah Az-Zukhruf dịka onye Allah nụrụ mkpesa ya.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Uzaị
Onye enyi ahụ nke ji ụgbọ mmiri na-agagharị n'oké idei mmiri ahụ
Ohu ahụ nke jere ije n'elu mmiri
Onye na-arahụ ụra echedoro n'ime ọgba
Ohu ahụ nke wetara nkume n'osimiri

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịtamu ntamu nye Allah gbasara mmegbu nke ndị mmadụ
Ije ije n'elu mmiri n'oge oké ifufe
Ibu nkume gaa n'osimiri nke na-enweghị mmiri
Ịkwọ ụgbọ mmiri gafere nnukwu idei mmiri n'ime ụgbọ ahụ
Inweta mkpịsị ugodi nke nnukwu akụ̀
trial.answer: Ịtamu ntamu nye Allah gbasara mmegbu nke ndị mmadụ

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Mkpesa kpọmkwem a gwara Allah
Mkpanaka nke ghọrọ agwọ
E mere ka ọkụ dị jụụ ma dị jụụ
Ụgbọ mmiri na-ese n'elu mmiri
Azụ̀ ilo onye na-ejere ya ozi

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Allah nụrụ mkpesa ahụ wee kwado ịdị n'otu Chineke na ịbụ Onyenwe anyị kachasị elu
Ije ije n'enweghị nsogbu n'elu mmiri n'oge oké ifufe
Ịgafe nnukwu idei mmiri n'ime ụgbọ ahụ n'enweghị nsogbu
Ịhụ ihe n'ime obí mpako
Inweta ọchịchị nke gbasaa site n'Ọwụwa Anyanwụ ruo Ọdịda Anyanwụ
outcome.answer: Allah nụrụ mkpesa ahụ wee kwado ịdị n'otu Chineke na ịbụ Onyenwe anyị kachasị elu

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
